description_html:
Ambient tracks from The Midwinter Mini’s “Death By Dice Album” that replace the main menu music.

Contains all eight tracks

1. This World Knows No Emperor

2. A New World, A New Start

3. The Black Stone, Chapter II

4. One Last Sunrise

5. Breathing Protocol

6. Underhive Stalker

7. Voidcraft Omens

8. At What Cost

This music isn’t mine (Duh) and belongs to Midwinter Minis. Please support the creator by buying the album through his bandcamp if you can!
